Compare ablations on identical validation users, histories, 99 unique negatives and evaluator settings. Record each user’s binary hit; compute Δ = ¼Σcategory mean(hit_ablation − hit_baseline). One additional hit changes category HR by 0.5 percentage points and macro HR by 0.125 points. Keep the pinned sampled metric: sampled ranking can disagree with full-catalog ranking, so improvements support claims about this benchmark. [Krichene and Rendle](https://research.google/pubs/on-sampled-metrics-for-item-recommendation/).

Recommended uncertainty analysis: bootstrap 200 users with replacement independently within each category, preserving each user’s paired outcomes across models. Recompute the equally weighted macro difference for 10,000 replicates; report its 95% percentile interval alongside category differences and intervals. Resample users, never individual candidates; keep all four categories represented. Pairing preserves covariance and directly estimates uncertainty in the difference. [SciPy bootstrap documentation](https://docs.scipy.org/doc/scipy/reference/generated/scipy.stats.bootstrap.html). These intervals assume users represent their category populations and condition on trained checkpoints and fixed candidate sets; they exclude training-seed variability, candidate-resampling variability and uncertainty about unseen categories. Few discordant outcomes can produce unstable or degenerate intervals.

Repeated hyperparameter trials and checkpoint selection overfit finite validation data; ordinary bootstrap intervals around the selected winner do not correct this selection bias. [Cawley and Talbot](https://www.jmlr.org/beta/papers/v11/cawley10a.html). Practical safeguards: predeclare a small ablation slate, equal tuning budgets, checkpoint evaluation schedules and tie-breaking rules; log every attempted configuration and validation look. Compute bootstrap diagnostics from cached outcomes without GPU retraining. Treat small selected gains as exploratory, favor simpler models when evidence is inconclusive, and freeze selection before the host’s independent held-out evaluation. Keep seed 42 and the prescribed splits unchanged.
